# Cooking Class Arezzo — Il Poggiolino d'Oro Apartment

> Hands-on Tuscan cooking classes in Arezzo, Italy: fresh handmade pasta and authentic tiramisù, taught by an expert chef in small groups, with unlimited local wines and a full meal of everything participants prepare.

## Key facts

- **What**: Hands-on cooking class — fresh handmade pasta + authentic Italian tiramisù
- **Where**: Il Poggiolino d'Oro Apartment, Viale Michelangelo 142, 52100 Arezzo (AR), Tuscany, Italy — walking distance from Arezzo train station, plenty of parking nearby. About 30 minutes from Cortona, ~1 hour from Florence, Siena and Perugia.
- **When**: Tuesday to Friday and Sundays (prior booking required). Time slots: 10:30, 13:00, 17:30.
- **Prices**:
  - Morning class (10:30): €69 per person
  - Lunch class (13:00): €79 per person
  - Afternoon class (17:30): €89 per person
- **Included**: hands-on cooking class; all ingredients and equipment; unlimited local wines; detailed recipes to take home; full meal with what you have prepared.
- **Group size**: small classes for personalized attention, guided by an expert chef.
- **Languages**: English and Italian.
- **Dietary needs**: vegetarian and other requirements accommodated on request.
- **Suitable for**: beginners, couples, families, groups of friends, solo travelers.

## Booking

- Phone: +39 346 9776103
- Mobile / WhatsApp: +39 346 9776103
- Email: ilpoggiolinodoro@gmail.com
- Prior booking is required.

## Reviews

Rated 5 stars by international guests from the USA, UK, Australia, Germany, Spain, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Denmark, Austria and more. Guests consistently highlight the friendly hosts, clear instruction, excellent house wine and the joy of eating what they made.
